source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only; the one live media turn ran on tier 'standard' with quota 12/100, so the degraded branch has no traffic. Reasoned from the node's own contract and the two specs it cites (plans/crm-image-degraded-tier-broken-spec.md, plans/crm-media-quota-notice-wording-spec.md).
source.rationale: The ONLY customer-facing string this node composes itself, so it is the one place a wording regression can originate in n8n rather than the CRM - which makes it the case most worth pinning byte-exact. Every one of the three gates must hold for it to fire: decision accepted, tier 'degraded', and the CRM attached no degraded/quota notice of its own (hasCrmDegradedNotice scans both kind and text, so a CRM notice would suppress this and avoid a double-telling). The verb is modality-dependent ('listening' for voice, 'reading' for image); the limit is parenthesised only because quota.limit is present, and the reset sentence only because resets_on is. The composed text is appended to the confirmation with a blank line, never returned instead of it, and is also stamped on _media_trace.synthetic_degraded_notice so an operator reading the trace can tell CRM copy from n8n copy.
